claims.claim: The DP Compact Portable Rechargeable LED Torch Light is suitable for homes, security personnel,...
claims.evidence: Photos show a rechargeable-looking portable LED torch, but suitability/DP Compact model name is not readable and no specs (runtime/brightness) are shown.

risks.risk: Wrong model/brand (seller says “DP Compact” but the photos don’t show that name/model on the torch).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the torch label/engraving showing the exact brand/model (and any lumen rating) plus the charging port area.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic rechargeable LED torch with unknown brightness/runtime.

risks.risk: Battery health/actual runtime may be poor (no runtime test shown).
risks.proof: Video showing it fully charged, then running on the brightest mode for a timed duration (e.g., 30–60 minutes) with brightness level visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as low/unknown runtime (worst case: not holding charge well).

risks.risk: Charging functionality not confirmed (no charger/charging cable or charging indicator shown).
risks.proof: Photo/video of the charging process: plug in charger, show charging indicator/light, then show it turning on after charging.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not guaranteed to charge properly until tested.

risks.risk: Condition issues (dents, cracked casing, loose switch) not fully visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Clear photos of all sides, the switch/button, and the lens/reflector area; plus a close-up of any seams/ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as used with possible cosmetic wear and unverified mechanical condition.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the torch’s label/engraving showing the exact brand/model (“DP Compact”) and any lumen rating.
Close-up of the charging port and the included charger/cable (show the exact connector type).
Short video: charging indicator ON, then torch ON after charging.
Timed runtime test video on the brightest setting.
response.reason: The photos confirm a portable rechargeable LED torch/light, but the key pricing drivers (exact model/brightness and battery/charging performance) are not readable or test-proven. Without that, a correct worst-case price can’t be confidently set.
